Gurdjieff and Armenian Medieval Sacred and Ritual Music
2026-09-04
Price 3000, 4000, 5000 AMD
On September 4 at 7:30 PM, the Armenia State Chamber Choir and the Gurdjieff Ensemble will present the concert "Gurdjieff and Armenian Medieval Sacred and Ritual Music" at the Komitas Chamber Music Hall.

Artistic Director and Principal Conductor of the Armenian State Chamber Choir: People’s Artist of the Republic of Armenia Robert Mlkeyan 
Artistic Director and Arranger of the Gurdjieff Ensemble: Levon Eskenian

The Gurdjieff Ensemble will present the Yerevan premiere of its new program. The program brings together the music of G. I. Gurdjieff, Armenian medieval sacred music, and ritual musical traditions, giving them a new resonance through Levon Eskenian’s delicate and distinctive arrangements.

The concert is intended for audiences aged 6 and above.
Time: 19:00.

Organizer: National Center for Chamber Music SNCO

Open-Air Concert: Khachatur Avetisyan - 100
2026-09-10
Price 3000, 5000, 8000, 10000 AMD
On September 10, at 8:00 p.m., a concert will be held on the open-air stage of the Komitas Chamber Music Hall Park dedicated to the 100th anniversary of the composer Khachatur Avetisyan, one of the most prominent representatives of Armenian music of the 20th century.

The popular songs and dances of the beloved composer, written with national spirit and melodic richness, will be performed by the “Tagharan” ancient music ensemble.

The soloists performing during the evening will be:
• Vardan Badalyan,
• Arpi,
• Mavr Mkrtchyan,
• Lusine Markosyan,
• Gayane Ghambaryan,
• Aramo Mamikonian
• Maarianna Gevorgyan
• and Zakar Keshishian.

Artistic director and conductor of the "Tagharan" ensemble: Sedrak Yerkanyan.
The concert is held with the support of the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sport of the Republic of Armenia.

The concert is intended for audiences aged 6 and above.
Time: 20:00.

Organizer: National Center for Chamber Music SNCO

Brahms & Tchaikovsky: Opening Concert of the 2026–2027 Concert Season
2026-09-11
Price 3000, 4000, 5000, 7000 AMD
On September 11 at 7:00 PM, we warmly invite you to the Komitas Chamber Music Hall to attend a concert by the National Chamber Orchestra of Armenia and enjoy works by Johannes Brahms and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky.

This concert holds special significance, as it will mark the opening of the 2026–2027 concert season of both the National Centre of Chamber Music and the National Chamber Orchestra of Armenia.

Artistic Director & Principal Conductor of the National Chamber Orchestra of Armenia: Vag Papyan
Soloist: pianist Armine Grigoryan

Program:
• Johannes Brahms: Piano Quintet in F minor, Op. 34
• Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky: Serenade for Strings in C major, Op. 48

The concert is intended for audiences aged 6 and above.
Time: 19:00.

Play or Event for Kids and Teens | Komitas Chamber Music House
Organ Tales: A Journey into the Magical World of the Organ
2026-09-15
Price 3000, 4000, 5000 AMD
On September 15, at 7:00 PM, the Komitas Chamber Music Hall will host a concert-performance entitled "Organ Tales: A Journey into the Magical World of the Organ".

The audience will discover the magical world of organ tales in a new spirit and mood. 

In the format of a fairy tale and interesting scenario solutions, beloved actress Hasmik Verdyan will introduce children to the magical world of the organ through games and jokes, turning an ordinary evening into a real musical fairy tale.

And talented organists Lusine Harutyunyan and Anna Bakunts will transport children to the world of organ sounds with live performances, through beautiful melodies from Bach to Harry Potter. Organist Harutyun Tagvoryan will play the role of the dwarf.

Children will not only listen to music, but also become a part of the story, participating in games and discovering how the organ can speak the language of music.

Dear parents, do not miss this musical meeting. This is a unique opportunity to combine art and play, education and entertainment.

Time: 19:00.
The concert-performance is intended for children aged 4 and older.

An Evening of Piano Works by Armenian Composers։ Anahit Nersisyan, Isabella Marutyan
2026-09-17
Price 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000 AMD
On September 17 at 7:00 PM, pianists Anahit Nersisyan, Honored Artist of Armenia, international competition laureate, and Isabella Marutyan, international competition laureate, will give a solo concert at the Komitas Chamber Music Hall.

The works by the greatest masters of 20th-century Armenian classical music G. Saryan, A. Khudoyan, E. Mirzoyan, A. Arutyunian, A. Babajanyan, and G. Hovunts will be performed.

The concert is dedicated to the Independence Day of the Republic of Armenia.

Program:
• Ghazaros Saryan: "Three Postludes"
• Adam Khudoyan: "Elegy," "Nostalgia," "Vision," "Humoresque"
• Edward Mirzoyan: "Tokatina," "Poem"
• Alexander Arutyunian: "The Wind Blows in the Mountains," "Dance of the Sasuns," three pieces from the "Six Moods" series
• Arno Babajanyan: "Capriccio," "Choral Music," "Dance of the Sasuns," "Poem"
• Gagik Hovunts: Two pieces - "Monogram" (dedicated to A. Arutyunian and A. Babajanyan)
• Edvard Mirzoyan: "Lezginka" (from the dance suite) arranged for two pianos by Martin Vardazaryan
• Alexander Arutyunyan & Arno Babajanyan: "Armenian Rhapsody" for two pianos

Host: Olya Nurijyanyan

The concert is intended for audiences aged 6 and above.
Time: 19:00.

Organizer: National Center for Chamber Music SNCO

National Chamber Orchestra of Armenia: Ahead of the Asia Tour
2026-09-18
Price 3000, 4000, 5000, 7000 AMD
On September 18 at 19:00, the National Chamber Orchestra of Armenia will present its concert Ahead of the Asia Tour at the Komitas Chamber Music Hall. The concert will be conducted by Sipan Olah (United Kingdom) — conductor, tenor, and concert artistic director.

Armenian audiences will have the exclusive opportunity to experience the concert program that the Orchestra will perform during its upcoming Asia tour, showcasing the rich heritage of Armenian classical music.

The soloists: 
• Shoghig Torossian: soprano, Lebanon
• Katarine Hovsepyan: piano
• Astghik Vardanyan: violin 

The program:
Part I
• Eduard Mirzoyan: “Festive waltz” 
• Alexander Spendiaryan: “Yerevan Sketches”- Enzeli, “To Rose” romance
• Khachatur Avetisyan: “Blossomed Chary tree”
• Arno Babajanian: “Aria Vocalise”, “Nocturne”, “Bring me back the music”, “Our Beloved Yerevan”
• Vagharshak Kotoyan: “My Yevean”  
• Aram Khachaturian: “Khachatriana suite” 
Part II
• Edvard Grieg: “Holberg suite” Op. 40 

Throughout the evening, the exhibition hall of the concert venue will feature a photo exhibition dedicated to the 155th anniversary of Alexander Spendiaryan’s birth, presenting photographs from the collection of the Alexander Spendiaryan House-Museum.

We warmly invite you to enjoy the finest works of Armenian and world classical music and to join us in wishing the National Chamber Orchestra of Armenia a successful and memorable Asia tour.

The concert is intended for audiences aged 6 and above.
Time: 19:00.

Organizer: National Center for Chamber Music SNCO

The 4th International Organ Festival: Opening Concert
2026-09-26
Price 3000, 4000, 5000 AMD
On September 26, at 7:00 PM, the grand opening concert of Vahagn Stamboltsyan Fourth International Organ Festival, dedicated to Komitas, will take place at the Komitas Chamber Music Hall.

At the festival’s grand opening concert, organists Harutyun Tagvoryan, Tereza Voskanyan, Lusin Sarajyan, Karine Hovhannisyan, Anna Arustamyan, and Davit Hovhannisyan will perform, alongside soprano Irina Zakyan, Armenian flute player Hasmik Harutyunyan, and cellist Andranik Aghajanyan.

The evening will also feature the Gurdjieff Ensemble, led by Artistic Director Levon Eskenyan.

In the program:

Harutyun Tagvoryan
• Komitas: “Hymn of Censing”, “Amen Holy is the Father”
• Makar Yekmalyan: "Bless the Lord, O Jerusalem"
• Komitas: "Alagyaz", "Incense Tree"
Hasmik Harutyunyan (Armenian flute)

Lusin Sarajyan
• Grigor Pahlavuni/Komitas: "Hymn of the Blessing of Water"
• Nerses Shnorhali/Makar Yekmalyan: "Amen Hayr Surb" 

Karine Hovhannisyan
• Arthur Avanesov: "You are Like a Plane Tree"

Gurdjieff Ensemble
• Komitas: "O Deep Mystery" (arr. by L. Eskenian) 

Tereza Voskanyan
• G. Narekatsi/E. Yerkanyan: "Bird"
• Gary Kesayan: "Prelude" for organ
• Gary Kesayan: "Ave Maria"
Irina Zakyan (soprano, Honored Artist of the Republic of Armenia)

Armen Aghajanyan
• Grigor Narekatsi: "Havoun Havoun" (arr. by Sergey Aghajanyan)
• Eduard Baghdasaryan: Excerpt from the Armenian liturgy
Andranik Aghajanyan (cello)

Davit Hovhannisyan
• Mikael Tariverdiev: "The Little Prince"

Anna Arustamyan
• Eduard Hayrapetyan: "The Sharakans" (The spiritual chants) 3 Palimpsests by Nerses Shnorhali for organ (premiere)

The concert is intended for audiences aged 6 and above.
Time: 19:00.

Organizer: National Center for Chamber Music SNCO
